title: Clarify startup instructions
body: Corrects the documentation command. No executable files change.
diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1 @@
-Run service
+Run `app serve`

checked: cmd/app/main.go: the serve command exists and starts the server.

title: Drop the account records table
body: This migration runs automatically on deployment against production. No backup or replacement table is created.
diff:
diff --git a/migrations/004.sql b/migrations/004.sql
--- /dev/null
+++ b/migrations/004.sql
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+DROP TABLE accounts;

impact: migrations/004.sql permanently deletes account records; reverting application code cannot restore them.

findings.title: Retain account records
findings.explanation: Dropping accounts destroys production data without a replacement or backup.

title: Allow the service to manage users
body: Grants the application login administrative privileges in production.

summary.take: Gives the application login superuser access.
impact: roles.sql grants administrative access to production data to app. A revert cannot undo actions taken while it held access.

findings.title: Keep the application role unprivileged
findings.explanation: The app login can now read all production data and change every role.
